IsAllowed.maps_to: is_allowed (sts2_rl/relics/old_coin.py:34) -> is_before_act3_treasure_chest (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:82-84), consulted by RunState._drop_disallowed_from_grab_bag (sts2_rl/run.py:769) before every pool pull
IsAllowed.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: pool eligibility is modelled now. `Relic.is_allowed(run)` exists on the sim's base (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:198, default True) and this relic overrides it with `is_before_act3_treasure_chest(run)` (sts2_rl/relics/old_coin.py:34), the `TotalFloor < 41` predicate of RelicModel.IsBeforeAct3TreasureChest (RelicModel.cs:452-456). RunState._drop_disallowed_from_grab_bag (sts2_rl/run.py:769) applies it before EVERY pull and REMOVES the rejects from the bag -- pull_relic_from_front (run.py:731), pull_relic_from_back (run.py:752) and the Shop-rarity bag (run.py:783) are the only three pull paths -- mirroring RelicGrabBag.RemoveDisallowedRelicsFromDeques (RelicGrabBag.cs:218-270), and `Relic.is_allowed_at_neow` now DELEGATES to is_allowed (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:211-222 = RelicModel.cs:443-446) so the Neow pools (sts2_rl/events/neow.py:72) cannot read a stale flag. Verified by execution against today's code: every one of the 17 cluster members returns is_allowed False at total_floor 60 and True at floor 0. WAS: the sim's Relic base declared no is_allowed member at all and populate_relic_grab_bags shuffled the pool once at run init with no per-pull filter, so the relic stayed pullable for the whole run and a late pull also shifted every subsequent pull.

guards.what: N1: `PlayerCmd.GainGold`'s companion event `Hook.AfterModifyingGoldGained` (PlayerCmd.cs:145) has no sim counterpart
guards.issue: This is the missing-AfterModifying-companion family that audit/records/seam/power_cmd.json gap G4 records and that relic/bag_of_preparation N1 already verdicted `gap` at the hand-draw dispatcher; one verdict per mechanism, binding rule 3. Observed at the GOLD dispatcher: run.gain_gold (run.py:325-333) chains modify_gold_gained over the run's relics and returns a bare number, with no modifiers list and no companion event. DORMANT, checked rather than assumed: `grep -rn 'def modify_gold_gained' sts2_rl/ --include=*.py` returns exactly one listener outside the base class, relics/ectoplasm.py:26, which overrides no companion, so nothing of any ported behaviour is lost. Recorded here rather than at G1 because a correct Old Coin port lands squarely in this pipeline and should not be blamed for inheriting the gap. Also noted: C# additionally fires Hook.AfterGoldGained, which .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md Sweep C correctly lists as having no sim hook at all. Rule 7: PlayerCmd.cs, run.py, relics/ectoplasm.py, relics/bag_of_preparation.py, the power_cmd record and the sweeps document are NOT hashed by this record.

guards.what: N2: `PlayerCmd.GainGold`'s truncation and non-positive bail (PlayerCmd.cs:141-149) vs run.gain_gold
guards.rationale: C# runs the modify chain, bails on `!(amount > 0)`, and banks `(int)amount`; run.gain_gold (run.py:325-333) runs the chain, computes `gained = int(amount)` and adds it only `if amount > 0`. Same order, same truncation toward zero, same guard. Recorded because it is the pipeline a fixed G1 lands in, and because the guard is load-bearing for relic/ectoplasm, which returns 0 from modify_gold_gained. Rule 7: PlayerCmd.cs, run.py and relics/ectoplasm.py are unhashed here.
